Summary

Add information about the widespread lack of support for stale-if-error Cache-Control header directive.
Documentation extensively describes this directive, even though not a single browser supports it, and the documentation does not mention this detail at all.

items.content_html:
Summary

This PR is part of my work to make sure all Wasm pages have working BCD and display it properly in their "Specifications" and "Browser compatibility" sections.

In particular, this PR adds granular data for all Wasm table instructions and variable instructions.

The table pages were originally displaying the data for webassembly.reference-types, so I duplicated that data for these data points.

The global variable pages already had data.

The local variables have been supported since the start, so I gave them the same "original" data as seen at webassembly.api.

Test results and supporting details

Related issues
items.title: Add granular data for Wasm table and variable instructions

items.content_html:
Summary

Removing data for the offline-enabled manifest key, which was supported by Chrome in Manifest V2 (Firefox and Safari never supported this key). The feature was marked as deprecated in WebExtensions - fix up all the tags except for apis #25117. Chrome ceased support for Manifest V2 in version 139.

Related issues

Related content changes in PR mdn/content#44823
items.title: Remove the offline-enabled manifest key
